scope: Predeclared12primary VAL windows +3 EGO anchors; direction check, not final paper acceptance
decision: Consider further development only when paired treatment improves hidden error beyond ordinary continuation without material visible/temporal regressions. No automatic promotion or new long training.

diagnostic_thresholds.ego: all retained EGO outputs exactly equal
diagnostic_thresholds.hidden_macro: Report clean/noisy and sceneON/OFF separately; >=3% beyond both base/control treated as promising direction, not validation of final model
diagnostic_thresholds.catastrophic_windows: Report reference-worse>=50mm counts and known yoga case; average alone insufficient
